label: pjm 99 offer surface
definition: (PROBE — REJECTED, no-op) PJM 99: pjm-98 keeper recipe (byte-faithful replay off its meta.json) + pjm_offer_surface_conditional=True — the G-22 lever-A measured PJM energy-offer surface (DataMiner2 energy_market_offers top-of-curve distribution, 36 months, condition-binned by within-year net-load percentile) posted onto the CC_REGULAR + CT_PEAKER peak-band rungs, P1-only. Zero fitted scalars in the delta (scripts/derive_pjm_offer_surface.py; rules 13/20/21). RESULT: price-identical to the same-day pjm-98 baseline in all 3 years — the repriced upper rungs never become marginal (0.3 GWh dispatched) because the summer-peak dual is capped by the 21-24 GW sub-actual-price mid-curve (idle coal $28-55, CT econ $42-115, ST_GAS $42-110), not the peak band. Falsifies the 'too-cheap top' scoping; re-scopes G-22 to the measured mid-curve + DA procurement depth (docs/FINDING-pjm-offer-surface-noop-2026-07.md). Mechanism + frozen surface stay (rule 1; they bind once the body is fixed). Scorer note: the C8 CT_PEAKER grounded-pass flip vs pjm-98 is rung-split attribution noise (0.02 TWh, 0.1% of class, cross-attributed floor MWh; the grounded-pass has no de-minimis on the mechanism list) — not a real forcing change (dispatch totals identical).
